title: Pais on Theory of Everything: plasma as doorway
summary: Dave Rossi tells of Pais on Theory of Everything: plasma as doorway, about undated at Theory of Everything podcast, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: what Dr. In my opinion, not to speak for him, but that's what Dr. Pye spoke about when he was on Curt Jaimungal's Theory of Everything when he said that it's possible that you can induce these types of effects like inertial mass reduction and so on. Not with solids, but with plasmas

plain: A man named Dave Rossi, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, points to something an engineer named Salvatore Pais said on Theory of Everything, a podcast hosted by Curt Jaimungal. In Rossi's reading, Pais said you might make an object act as if it had less mass, so it is easier to move, by working with plasma, a hot, electrically charged gas, rather than solid material. If true, plasma could be the key to the strange flight that UFOs are said to show.
